headlines.title: PDD Holdings (PDD) Stock Looks Cheap After A 39% Slide
headlines.summary: PDD Holdings has seen its share price fall sharply over the past year, which puts a spotlight on one basic question for investors: Is the current valuation still in line with what the business is earning today and what those earnings may support over time? The stock is down 39.5% over the past year, which raises the issue of whether the market is reassessing what its earnings power is worth.

headlines.title: Learn Why The Bull Case For PDD Holdings Stock Could Change Following Texas Data Settlement
headlines.summary: PDD Holdings and its Temu unit previously settled a deceptive trade practices lawsuit with the Texas Attorney General, agreeing to a US$3 million payment, U.S. data storage for Texans’ information, and recurring audits with financial penalties tied to any material noncompliance. The Texas judgment embeds higher compliance and data governance costs into PDD Holdings’ operations, which can affect margin flexibility and future investment choices across its commerce platforms.

headlines.title: PDD Holdings (PDD) Faces A Texas Privacy Settlement As Undervalued Narrative Holds
headlines.summary: PDD Holdings (NasdaqGS:PDD) just closed a privacy lawsuit with the Texas Attorney General, agreeing to a US$3 million payment plus stricter data controls that directly affect how its Temu platform handles Texas consumer information. The privacy settlement lands at a tricky moment for PDD Holdings, with the share price at US$78.72 after a 1-day move that fell 3.56% and a year-to-date share price return that declined 31.99%. The 1-year total shareholder return is down 39.

headlines.title: PDD Holdings Inc. Sponsored ADR (PDD) Stock Sinks As Market Gains: What You Should Know
headlines.summary: In the closing of the recent trading day, PDD Holdings Inc. Sponsored ADR (PDD) stood at $78.72, denoting a -3.56% move from the preceding trading day.

headlines.title: China Tech Stocks Slide While U.S. Market Rises: Alibaba Sinks 5%, JD.com and PDD Drop 4%
headlines.summary: China's biggest artificial intelligence spender is leading a sharp retreat in U.S.-listed Chinese internet stocks even as American large caps push higher, raising questions about whether heavy cloud spending is becoming a liability rather than an advantage.

description: PDD Holdings Inc., a multinational commerce group that owns and operates a portfolio of businesses. The company operates Pinduoduo platform, which provides various product categories and interactive shopping experiences; and Temu, an online platform, which enables merchants to streamline their manufacturing and commercial operations. The company was formerly known as Pinduoduo Inc. and changed its name to PDD Holdings Inc. in February 2023. PDD Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Dublin, Ireland.
